citations.claim: body overlaps wall by 0.18 exceeding 0.15 limit at first violating step
one step before violation penetration was still within tolerance

counterfactual.change: Reduced |vx| from 13.15 to 2.0 (single field change) - lowers per-substep displacement so positional correction keeps penetration within tolerance

explanation: Body moving fast horizontally (-13.15 m/s) grazes the vertical face / corner region of wall (x=1.7,w=7.5 top edge y~8.8?). Substep collision correction fails to keep penetration under 0.15 tolerance; penetration grows from ~0.03 at step 18 to 0.18 at step 19. Reducing horizontal speed eliminates penetration, confirming high tangential velocity causes missed/ insufficient positional correction at wall edge.
vision_note: From steps 16 to 18 the red body grazes the bottom-right corner of the grey wall, staying just outside the wall. At step 19 a small cap of the red body is visibly inside the corner, overlapping the wall where it was previously just touching.
